description: This file defines internal implementations for aggregators in Apache Spark, including classes for sum (double and long), count, and average aggregators with support for Java API integration.

classes.name: TypedSumDouble
classes.description: Aggregator for summing Double values with Java API support.

classes.name: TypedSumLong
classes.description: Aggregator for summing Long values with Java API support.

classes.name: TypedCount
classes.description: Aggregator for counting non-null values with Java API support.

classes.name: TypedAverage
classes.description: Aggregator for computing average of Double values with Java API support.

methods.name: toColumnJava
methods.description: Converts the aggregator to a TypedColumn with Java Double or Long type.
